thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/04/2018: CRUS, SMAR, NXPI, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/04/2018: CRUS, SMAR, NXPI, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.01%
AAPL: -2.00%
IBM: Flat
CSCO: -0.10%
GOOG: -0.49%
Tuesday pre-bell trading saw lower technology stocks.
Early movers include:
(-) Cirrus Logic ( CRUS ), which was down more than 6% after it cut its revenue guidance for the fiscal third quarter, blaming "recent weaknesses in the smartphone market."
(-) NXP Semiconductors N.V ( NXPI ) was over 3% lower after it priced its offering of $1 billion principal amount of 4.875% senior unsecured notes due 2024, $500 million principal amount of 5.35% senior unsecured notes due 2026, and $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.55% senior unsecured notes due 2028.
(+) Smartsheet ( SMAR ) was up more than 3% after the cloud-based platform for work execution provided upbeat outlook for the current fiscal quarter while reporting results that beat Wall Street expectations for the most recent quarter.
